mapper.insert: insert into shopping_cart (name, image, user_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, number, amount, create_time) VALUES (#{name},#{image},#{userId},#{dishId},#{setmealId},#{dishFlavor},#{number},#{amount},#{createTime})

update.if: update shopping_cart set number = #{number}, amount = #{amount} where user_id = #{userId} and setmeal_id = #{setmealId}
update shopping_cart set number = #{number}, amount = #{amount} where user_id = #{userId} and dish_id = #{dishId}

mapper.delete: delete from shopping_cart where user_id = #{userId} and dish_id = #{dishId}
delete from shopping_cart where user_id = #{currentId} and setmeal_id = #{setmealId}
mapper.select: select * from shopping_cart where user_id = #{userId} and dish_id = #{dishId}
select * from shopping_cart where user_id = #{currentId} and setmeal_id = #{setmealId}
